items.source: A Model return type has a set purpose. Therefore this handler should be configured ahead of handlers that support any return value type annotated with @ModelAttribute or @ResponseBody to ensure they don't take over.
items.translation: `Model` 返回类型具有特定用途。因此，此处理器应配置在支持任何返回值类型并标注有 `@ModelAttribute` 或 `@ResponseBody` 的处理器之前，以确保它们不会接管处理。

items.source: Handle the given return value by adding attributes to the model and setting a view or setting the ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean) flag to true to indicate the response has been handled directly.
items.translation: 处理给定的返回值，通过向模型添加属性并设置视图，或者将ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean)标志设置为true，以指示响应已直接处理。

items.source: Whether the given method return type is supported by this handler.
items.translation: 给定方法返回类型是否由该处理器支持。

items.source: mavContainer - the ModelAndViewContainer for the current request
items.translation: mavContainer - 当前请求的 ModelAndViewContainer

items.source: webRequest - the current request
items.translation: webRequest - 当前请求

items.source: Resolves a method parameter into an argument value from a given request. A ModelAndViewContainer provides access to the model for the request. A WebDataBinderFactory provides a way to create a WebDataBinder instance when needed for data binding and type conversion purposes.
items.translation: 将方法参数解析为来自给定请求的参数值。`ModelAndViewContainer` 提供对请求模型的访问。`WebDataBinderFactory` 提供了一种在需要数据绑定和类型转换时创建 `WebDataBinder` 实例的方法。
